_comment: Northbridge cafes, bars, pubs and restaurants, from tools/places/place_venues.py (tools/places/venues_src.json). position is the middle of the shopfront on the footpath at the building's wall; yaw turns scripts/world/venue.gd's frame (+z out to the street); width is the shopfront along the wall and depth the footpath out to the kerb; wall_top how high the building's wall goes; ground is the footpath's height above position on a 0.5 m grid (x from ground_x[0], ground_x[1] points, fastest; z from 0 out, ground_z points); obstacles are street trees and lights in front (kind, local x, z); pave, per ground_x column, how far out from the wall the ground is unpaved verge the model paves over. scene is the venue's model (art/models/scripts/build_venues.py).
